meta.title: Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort |  Vietnam Accommodation
meta.description: Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort is a serene beachfront escape just 30 minutes from Da Nang International Airport, set on the pristine sands of Binh Minh Beach. Opened in 2022, the resort offers elegant rooms, suites and bungalows designed for couples and families, blending Indochine style with modern comfort. Guests can relax by the ocean-facing infinity pool, enjoy family-friendly facilities, unwind at the spa, and savour fine dining and cocktails, with a complimentary shuttle making it easy to explore the charm of Hoi An Ancient Town.
